proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the issue on a test instance (v2.1.1), capture the exact code paths allowing template editing and media upload, determine whether admin authentication is required for execution, and apply patches or disable template/file editing and arbitrary PHP uploads until fixed.
